summary: Weekly status report follows the Deloitte Word template: header fields, narrative summary, bullet sections (initiatives, blockers, risks), milestone table, and supporting links. Derive content only from brief, WBS, and RAID.

header_fields.label: Project Name:
header_fields.description: Engagement or project title from the brief

header_fields.label: Project Manager:
header_fields.description: Named PM or lead from the brief when stated

header_fields.label: Date:
header_fields.description: Week ending or report date (ISO or brief format)

sections.label: Summary:
sections.description: High-level status; reference RAID decisions and progress

sections.label: New Initiatives:
sections.description: New actions from RAID; list of strings

sections.label: Blockers:
sections.description: Items needing management help; from RAID issues or WBS dependencies

sections.label: Risks:
sections.description: High-probability/high-impact risks from RAID; list of strings

sections.label: Milestones:
sections.description: Milestone table aligned to WBS timeline

sections.label: Details:
sections.description: Links to supporting documentation; list of strings

milestone_columns.description: Planned completion date derived from the WBS schedule (required on every milestone — avoid TBD unless the brief gives no timeline at all)
Client, Consultant, or Joint accountable side

generation_rules: Root JSON includes project_name, project_manager, date, summary, new_initiatives, blockers, risks, milestones, supporting_links.
new_initiatives, blockers, risks, and supporting_links are arrays of strings.
Each milestone object: name, target_date, actual_date (optional), owner_side, status.
owner_side must be Client, Consultant, or Joint (accountable party for the milestone, aligned with WBS owner_side).
Risks and blockers must trace to RAID; milestones must align with WBS.
Build the milestone table from WBS level-1 phases and key level-2 deliverables so the delivery plan is clear at a glance.
Every milestone must have a concrete target_date. Roll up WBS estimated_duration and dependencies into a coherent timeline; minimize TBD dates.
Infer target dates from brief milestones, phase durations, and WBS sequencing when explicit dates are not stated — use relative week/month offsets rather than leaving dates blank.
